svg.aria-label: Autodemolizione Ricambi Torino. The website for the customers of the same yard. A car drawn in technical lines "opens" zone by zone (engine bay, cabin, doors, rear, underbody, wheels) and shows which parts are in stock right now, connected to the back-office. No cookies and no personal data collected. Hosted on AWS Lightsail with automatic HTTPS.
